message.content: Based on the discussion, LiHua mentions "Spiritfarer" as a game that stands out for its emotional storytelling, particularly how it conveys themes of loss and letting go through gameplay without relying heavily on dialogue. LiHua notes that the art style and soundtrack amplify the sense of warmth and sorrow, indicating that Spiritfarer effectively uses its medium to create an emotional experience. This aligns with the description of Spiritfarer as a game that beautifully combines gameplay with powerful themes of loss and letting go.
